projectSummary: A web-based compliance management platform with client onboarding, contract workflows, and policy validation integrated into a Spring Boot and React stack.

tasks.title: Conduct stakeholder discovery workshop
tasks.description: Facilitate sessions with product, legal, and engineering leads to confirm goals, constraints, and success metrics. Document assumptions and out-of-scope items.

tasks.title: Define MVP scope and delivery roadmap
tasks.description: Break the proposal into MVP vs post-MVP features. Produce a phased roadmap with target dates aligned to budget and duration constraints.

tasks.title: Create system architecture diagram
tasks.description: Document frontend, API, database, and third-party integrations (AI, OCL). Include authentication flow and deployment topology.
dependencies: Define MVP scope and delivery roadmap

tasks.title: Implement user authentication and RBAC
tasks.description: Build JWT-based login, role-based route protection, and PM/company/client role mappings per security requirements.

tasks.title: Author end-to-end test suite for core workflows
tasks.description: Automate proposal submission, contract signing, and PM task generation flows. Include negative cases for auth and validation errors.

tasks.title: Configure CI/CD pipeline and staging environment
tasks.description: Set up build, test, and deploy stages for backend and frontend. Configure environment variables and secrets management.
dependencies: Author end-to-end test suite for core workflows

tasks.title: Establish monitoring and incident response runbook
tasks.description: Configure application logging, uptime alerts, and on-call procedures. Document rollback steps for failed deployments.
dependencies: Configure CI/CD pipeline and staging environment
